title: Continuous-Time Separation Screening for Aircraft Heading Instructions

frame.reference_inputs: Exact binary64 API inputs; retain hexadecimal representations

execution_models.N: Both speeds fixed at nominal values; retain turns
execution_models.C: Each speed independently fixed within its interval over the horizon
execution_models.V: Each speed any independent measurable profile within its interval over the horizon

acceptance_rule: Every supplied ownship-traffic pair must be certified_safe; no claim about traffic-traffic pairs

reference.V: Independent support-function reachable sets, distance bounds and continuous-time subdivision
reference.C: Independent constant-speed reachable hulls and continuous-time subdivision
reference.rounding_evidence: High-precision numerical reference, not validated outward interval arithmetic
reference.conflict_evidence: Constructive admissible speed profiles and a time; independently integrate and verify
reference.safe_evidence: A continuous-time lower bound outside the classification exclusion band
implementation_gate: no production geometry or envelope used for the reference answer
reference.failure_gate: Investigate any reference conflict accepted by the library before running further study cases
reference.separated_criterion: Whole-horizon lower bound > separation threshold + 25 m, stable at 120 digits
reference.conflict_criterion: Independently checked attainable witness < separation threshold - 25 m, stable at 120 digits

timing.timed_unit: One complete menu, all 57 pair checks without early exit
timing.jit_compilation: warm before repeated measurements; cold startup reported separately
timing.reference_runtime: record as offline verification cost; no speedup ratio against optimised production

vertical_example.assumptions: Immediate monotone progress at or above the stated minimum, no overshoot, remain at selected level; no altitude-error allowance

selection_policy: Retain every predeclared input and unresolved outcome; no outcome-dependent case replacement
evidence: generated inputs with source and configuration hashes
reproduction manifest and generated figure data
nominal_model_reuse: 228 distinct nominal queries may be reused across the four width groups; do not treat these as independent replications
